prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, towering hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a towering frame with legs that seem endless, thick smooth thighs and calves, hips wide and rounded, a sharply cinched narrow waist pulled in far tighter than her bust and hips, and a full heavy bust high on her chest; her height and long legs make every curve look longer and more dramatic; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, shaggy layered dark brown hair — wearing a skin-tight ultra-high-cut school-swimsuit-style one-piece of ultra-thin matte navy spandex with wide shoulder straps, a white name patch with a small number on the left of her chest, thin white piping along the neckline and the leg openings, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to her belly button and the two sides of the spandex fully covering her bust, the leg openings cut extremely high up to the very top of her hip bones, her arms and legs bare, the swimsuit shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin and fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin spandex molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the white name patch and the thin white piping crisp against the navy, fine stretch lines and a soft matte sheen. Pose: sitting on the leather ear cushion with one leg stretched out long and the other knee bent, leaning back on one hand planted behind her, the other hand resting on her knee, chest lifted, chin raised, her legs fully in view — most extreme towering hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy navy leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in navy lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: large round eyes with bright real catchlights, thick curled lashes with drawn-on lower lashes, soft pink and lilac eyeshadow, round pink blush, glossy cherry-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows light natural skin glow, subtle healthy sheen.

Background: a wooden desk in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: a pair of gigantic black over-ear headphones lies on the desk with soft leather ear cushions as big as sofas and a thick curled cable, a giant guitar pick and a giant USB stick beside it, a softly blurred music room with warm lamps far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall sitting on the leather ear cushion with the giant objects rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by warm lamp light with soft shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous headphones, cable and guitar pick around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
